LanguageData.Gun_Winchester_M1873_RWP.label: Winchester M1873
LanguageData.Gun_Winchester_M1873_RWP.description: The Winchester M1873 is a lever-action rifle known for its reliability and ease of use. A legendary firearm of the Old West, it offers a respectable range and accuracy, making it a solid choice for mid-range engagements. Its sturdy design holds up well in combat, proving effective even by modern standards.
